lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh duneeaa aavan jaaneeaa ||3||
lines.translation: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: vich duneeaa sev kamaaeeai ||
lines.translation: In the midst of this world, do seva,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa daragah baisan paaeeai ||
lines.translation: and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak baah ludaaeeai ||4||33||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau satigur sevee aapanaa ik man ik chit bhaai ||
lines.translation: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus my consciousness on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur man kaamanaa teerath hai jis no dei bujhaai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those unto whom He has given this understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man chi(n)diaa var paavanaa jo ichhai so phal paai ||
lines.translation: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naau dhiaaeeai naau ma(n)geeai naame sahaj samaai ||1||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere har ras chaakh tikh jaai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall be quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee guramukh chaakhiaa sahaje rahe samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tinee paaiaa naam nidhaan ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar har ras rav rahiaa chookaa man abhimaan ||
lines.translation: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai kamal pragaasiaa laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||
lines.translation: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man niramal har rav rahiaa paaiaa daragahi maan ||2||
lines.translation: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored in His Court. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa te virale sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mamataa maar kai har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinaa naame lagaa piaar ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: seee sukheee chahu jugee jinaa naam akhut apaar ||3||
lines.translation: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happy throughout the four ages. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur miliai naam paaeeai chookai moh piaas ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachment departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har setee man rav rahiaa ghar hee maahi udaas ||
lines.translation: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home of the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa har kaa saad aaiaa hau tin balihaarai jaas ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai sach naam gunataas ||4||1||34||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||4||1||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu bhekh kar bharamaaeeai man hiradai kapat kamaai ||
lines.translation: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa mahal na paavaee mar visataa maahi samaai ||1||
lines.translation: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink into manure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re grih hee maahi udaas ||
lines.translation: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee so kare guramukh hoi paragaas ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man jeetiaa gat mukat gharai mahi paai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains the State of Liberation in one's own home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaaeeai satasa(n)gat mel milaai ||2||
lines.translation: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: je lakh isatareeaa bhog karahi nav kha(n)d raaj kamaahi ||
lines.translation: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the nine continents of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin satagur sukh na paavaee phir phir jonee paahi ||3||
lines.translation: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਹਿਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har haar ka(n)th jinee pahiriaa gur charanee chit laai ||
lines.translation: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa pichhai ridh sidh phirai onaa til na tamaai ||4||
lines.translation: -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for such things at all. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo prabh bhaavai so theeai avar na karanaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jeevai naam lai har devahu sahaj subhaai ||5||2||35||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35||
